Pre-stated rule: record only if 10-seed means improve by >=0.0005 on BOTH validation and single-split backtest -> passed (+0.0008 / +0.0008). Rolling origin is -0.0004 (4 seeds) and the deterministic two-view test with both other encodings present was +0.0009 / -0.0004, so evidence is mixed like the second encoding
